items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I was with Duke at the time

ctx.x: This was in '61 or '62, somewhere around there -- maybe '63 even. So we came here to the Apollo, and we played at the Apollo; I was with Duke at the time -- and it was all right. But Duke wanted to go into Basin Street East, and they told me I had to have a cabaret card to play there. So I couldn't get a cabaret card, being that I had been busted in New York. And I had to get somebody to be a champion for me, like Reverend Gensel, you know. He did me a lot of good as far getting my card. But I did him a lot of…
Right, in the early days of him getting started with the Jazz at the Church.

items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I was with Duke, and I couldn't get... Duke was going into Basin... I was with Duke at the time... I could work at Basin Street East with Woody Herman's band, but I couldn't do it with Duke Ellington's band.

ctx.x: "McGhee Special" -- I featured that with him, too. What else did I...? I had another thing there, too, that I keep trying to think of what it was. [SINGS 8 BARS] It's Duke's tune. I wrote it up for Charlie.
